title: Bug: test_iface_namingmode.py - sometimes interface is missing from show_lldp_table after link flap
author: Javier-Tan
body:
### Is it platform specific

generic

### Importance or Severity

Low

### Description of the bug

When running `test_iface_namingmode.py` tests, sometimes the `test_show_lldp_table` test (specifically with naming-mode = default) will fail because an entry is missing from the LLDP table.

LLDP table which is missing entry causing failures:
```
test_iface_namingmode.test_show_lldp_tab L0266 INFO   | lldp_table:
Capability codes: (R) Router, (B) Bridge, (O) Other
LocalPort    RemoteDevice    RemotePortID    Capability    RemotePortDescr
-----------  --------------  --------------  ------------  -----------------
Ethernet32   ARISTA01T3      Ethernet1       BR
Ethernet40   ARISTA01T3      Ethernet2       BR
Ethernet64   ARISTA03T3      Ethernet1       BR
Ethernet208  ARISTA04T3      Ethernet1       BR
Ethernet216  ARISTA04T3      Ethernet2       BR
--------------------------------------------------
Total entries displayed:  5
```
Full LLDP table:
```
test_iface_namingmode.test_show_lldp_tab L0266 INFO   | lldp_table:
Capability codes: (R) Router, (B) Bridge, (O) Other
LocalPort    RemoteDevice    RemotePortID    Capability    RemotePortDescr
-----------  --------------  --------------  ------------  -----------------
Ethernet32   ARISTA01T3      Ethernet1       BR
Ethernet40   ARISTA01T3      Ethernet2       BR
Ethernet64   ARISTA03T3      Ethernet1       BR
Ethernet184  ARISTA06T3      Ethernet1       BR
Ethernet208  ARISTA04T3      Ethernet1       BR
Ethernet216  ARISTA04T3      Ethernet2       BR
--------------------------------------------------
Total entries displayed:  6
```

This is caused by a timing issue by `test_config_interface_state` performing `shutdown` and `startup` on an interface, sometimes the LLDP is not repopulated in time. (This is the reason it only happens on naming-mode default when running the entire suite, because `test_config_interface_state` is not run before naming-mode alias)

### Steps to Reproduce

Run `test_config_interface_state` and `test_show_lldp_table` back to back to hit the same issue.

NOTE: We had a lot of trouble reporducing the issue when running the whole test suite locally or individually, it seems to trigger fairly often on full nightly runs. See timing calculations below for more information

### Actual Behavior and Expected Behavior

Test `test_config_interface_state` performs `shutdown` and `startup`, and the lldp table is not repopulated in time when it should be.

### Relevant log output

```shell
Some calculations:

Timings from "startup Ethernetxxx" to "show lldp table":
Fail in nightly:
12:51:20.938949
12:51:42.015427
~22s
13:01:45.866642
13:02:07.040900
~22s

Local successes:
02:47:48.768387
02:48:14.980429
~26s
02:58:34.127990
02:59:00.477481
~26s

Manual benchmark is very variable as it always takes longer the first time (?):

admin@bjw-can-7250-lc2-1:~$ sudo config interface -n asic1 shutdown Ethernet208; sleep 3s; sudo config interface -n asic1 startup Ethernet208; date; watch -n 0 -g show lldp t
able; date
Wed Mar 19 03:26:18 AM UTC 2025
Wed Mar 19 03:26:40 AM UTC 2025
~22s
```

### Output of `show version`

```shell
N/A
```
